CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sgp_consultar_nc_vidrio(p_token text, p_semana integer DEFAULT NULL::integer)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare u text; begin u:=sgp_validar_sesion_rol(p_token,array['ADMINISTRADOR','COORDINADOR','LIDER','CONSULTA']);
return jsonb_build_object(
 'semanas_abiertas',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(x.semana_maestro order by x.semana_maestro),'[]'::jsonb) from (select distinct semana_maestro from sgp_nc_vidrio where activo and upper(coalesce(estado_nc,''))='ABIERTA' and semana_maestro is not null)x),
 'rows',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(q) order by q.semana_maestro,q.fecha_generacion_nc,q.consecutivo),'[]'::jsonb) from (
 select n.*,greatest(current_date-coalesce(n.fecha_generacion_nc,n.fecha_repo,current_date),0) dias_abierta
 from sgp_nc_vidrio n where n.activo and
 ((p_semana is null and n.semana_maestro in(select distinct semana_maestro from sgp_nc_vidrio where activo and upper(coalesce(estado_nc,''))='ABIERTA'))
 or n.semana_maestro=p_semana)
 )q)
); end $function$
